# Game Idea: Canvas Runner

A side‑scrolling endless runner on HTML canvas. The player taps or clicks to make the character jump over gaps and obstacles while the world scrolls left. Collect stars to boost score. Lose condition: hitting an obstacle or falling into a gap ends the game.

1: // Simple endless runner with improved graphics for canvas id="game"
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return; // safety
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
8: 
9:   // Game state
10:   const skyGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
11:   // Load sound effects (provide .wav/.mp3 files in same directory)
12:   const sounds = {
13:     jump: new Audio('jump.wav'),
14:     star: new Audio('star.wav'),
15:     gameOver: new Audio('gameover.wav'),
16:     // optional background music loop
17:     // bgm: (() => { const a = new Audio('bgm.mp3'); a.loop = true; a.volume = 0.3; return a; })()
18:   };
19:   // Uncomment below to start background music automatically
20:   // sounds.bgm && sounds.bgm.play();
21: 
22:   // parallax clouds
23:   skyGradient.addColorStop(0, '#4a90e2'); // top sky blue
24:   skyGradient.addColorStop(1, '#a1c4fd'); // bottom lighter
25: 
26:   // parallax clouds
27:   const clouds = [];
28:   function spawnCloud() {
29:     const y = Math.random() * (height * 0.5);
30:     const size = 30 + Math.random() * 50;
31:     clouds.push({x: width, y, size, speed: speed * 0.3});
32:   }
33:   let cloudTimer = 0;
34:   let score = 0;
35:   let gameOver = false;
36:   const gravity = 0.6;
37:   const jumpStrength = -12;
38:   const speed = 4; // world scroll speed
39: 
40:   const player = {
41:     x: 80,
42:     y: height - 60,
43:     w: 40,
44:     h: 40,
45:     vy: 0,
46:     onGround: true,
47:     draw() { ctx.fillStyle = '#0b8'; ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h); },
48:     update() {
49:       this.vy += gravity;
50:       this.y += this.vy;
51:       if (this.y + this.h >= height) {
52:         this.y = height - this.h;
53:         this.vy = 0;
54:         this.onGround = true;
55:       } else {
56:         this.onGround = false;
57:       }
58:     },
59:     jump() { if (this.onGround) { this.vy = jumpStrength; this.onGround = false; sounds.jump.currentTime = 0; sounds.jump.play(); } }
60:   };
61: 
62:   // obstacles and stars store {x, y, w, h, type}
63:   const obstacles = [];
64:   const stars = [];
65:   let spawnTimer = 0;
66: 
67:   function spawn() {
68:     // random gap between obstacles
69:     const gap = 150 + Math.random() * 100;
70:     const lastX = obstacles.length ? obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x : width;
71:     const obsX = lastX + gap;
72:     const obsHeight = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
73:     obstacles.push({x: obsX, y: height - obsHeight, w: 30, h: obsHeight, type: 'obstacle'});
74:     // maybe add a star above
75:     if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
76:       stars.push({x: obsX + 15, y: height - obsHeight - 60, r: 8, type: 'star'});
77:     }
78:   }
79: 
80:   function updateObjects(arr) {
81:     for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
82:       const o = arr[i];
83:       o.x -= speed;
84:       if (o.x + (o.w || o.r * 2) < 0) arr.splice(i, 1);
85:     }
86:   }
87: 
88:   function checkCollisions() {
89:     // player vs obstacles
90:     for (const o of obstacles) {
91:       if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x &&
92:           player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.h > o.y) {
93:         gameOver = true;
94:         sounds.gameOver.currentTime = 0;
95:         sounds.gameOver.play();
96:         break;
97:       }
98:     }
99:     // player vs stars
100:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
101:       const s = stars[i];
102:       const dx = (player.x + player.w/2) - (s.x + s.r);
103:       const dy = (player.y + player.h/2) - (s.y + s.r);
104:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
105: if (dist < player.w/2 + s.r) {
106:           score += 10;
107:           stars.splice(i, 1);
108:           sounds.star.currentTime = 0;
109:           sounds.star.play();
110:         }
111:     }
112:   }
113: 
114:   function draw() {
115:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
116:     // sky background
117:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient;
118:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
119:     // clouds
120:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
121:     clouds.forEach(c => {
122:       ctx.beginPath();
123:       ctx.arc(c.x + c.size/2, c.y + c.size/2, c.size/2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
124:       ctx.fill();
125:     });
126:     // ground line
127:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654';
128:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - 10, width, 10);
129:     // player (draw as rounded character)
130:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0b8';
131:     ctx.beginPath();
132:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.w/2, player.y + player.h/2, player.w/2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
133:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h); // keep rectangle base for collision
134:     // obstacles
135:     ctx.fillStyle = '#b33';
136:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
137:     // stars
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
139:     stars.forEach(s => {
140:       ctx.beginPath();
141:       ctx.arc(s.x + s.r, s.y + s.r, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
142:       ctx.fill();
143:     });
144:     // score
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
146:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
147:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 30);
148:     if (gameOver) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
150:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
152:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
153:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
154:     }
155:   }
156: 
157:   function loop() {
158:     if (!gameOver) {
159:       player.update();
160:       updateObjects(obstacles);
161:       updateObjects(stars);
162:       // update clouds
163:       for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
164:         const c = clouds[i];
165:         c.x -= c.speed;
166:         if (c.x + c.size < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
167:       }
168:       cloudTimer += speed;
169:       if (cloudTimer > 200) { spawnCloud(); cloudTimer = 0; }
170: 
171:       spawnTimer += speed;
172:       if (spawnTimer > 120) { spawn(); spawnTimer = 0; }
173:       checkCollisions();
174:       score += 0.1; // incremental score
175:     }
176:     draw();
177:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
178:   }
179: 
180:   // input handling
181:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => player.jump());
182:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); player.jump(); }, {passive:false});
183: 
184:   // start
185:   spawn();
186:   loop();
187: })();

(End of file - total 187 lines)
</content>
